dmn_experiences.title: Birmingham Beer Tasting Tour
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided walking tour visiting at least three Birmingham brewery taprooms and craft beer venues, with a drink included at each stop. Groups are capped at around 25 people.
highlights: At least three taproom stops with a drink at each
Flat, wheelchair-friendly route of about 1.5 miles
Small groups of up to around 25 people
Guided introduction to local beer styles and venues

dmn_experiences.title: Birmingham Microbrewery Experience
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided brewery tour visiting Rock and Roll Brewery, Burning Soul Brewery and The Wolf, with tastings at each stop and a cheese and charcuterie finish.
highlights: Tours and tastings at three local breweries
Beer samples at each stop
Cheese and charcuterie to finish
Small groups of up to 25 people

dmn_experiences.title: Sipsmith Gin Masterclass
dmn_experiences.summary: A gin masterclass at Be At One in Birmingham city centre, led by Sipsmith experts, with a welcome G&T and the chance to make two gin cocktails.
highlights: Sipsmith G&T on arrival
Expert-led gin tasting session
Make two gin cocktails behind the bar
Over-18s only

dmn_experiences.title: Barrel & Bond Whisky Tasting
dmn_experiences.summary: An SQA-accredited whisky tasting at The Old Joint Stock, with a curated flight of whiskies and matched food pairings, suitable for beginners and enthusiasts alike.
highlights: Led by an SQA-accredited whisky guide
Curated whisky flight with food pairings
A journey through whisky history and flavours
Over-18s only

dmn_experiences.title: Cocktail Masterclass
dmn_experiences.summary: A 90-minute cocktail masterclass at The Cocktail Club in Birmingham city centre, making two cocktails and taking part in a daiquiri challenge, with a welcome drink on arrival.
highlights: Bubbly welcome drink on arrival
Make two cocktails from a set selection
Take part in a daiquiri challenge
Over-18s only
